label: stand 1
title: Stand on your spot
instruction: Stand still on your spot in your guard, facing the camera. The game takes this as your home spot.

label: look around
title: Look around
instruction: Stay on your spot. Turn your head left and right, nod, look down at your feet and up. Do not step.

label: twist
title: Twist
instruction: Stay on your spot. Twist your shoulders left and right as if punching, lean a little. Do not step.

label: walk slow
title: Walk in place slowly
instruction: Walk in place on your spot, slowly, lifting your knees a little, facing the camera.

label: walk fast
title: Walk in place fast
instruction: Walk (or jog) in place on your spot, as fast as you comfortably can, facing the camera.

label: walk stop
title: Walk and stop
instruction: Each time you are called, START walking in place, or STOP and stand still.

label: turn left
title: Turn to the left
instruction: Stand on your spot. Each time you are called, turn your body (shoulders and hips) to your LEFT, or back to face the camera. Do not walk.

label: turn right
title: Turn to the right
instruction: Stand on your spot. Each time you are called, turn your body (shoulders and hips) to your RIGHT, or back to face the camera. Do not walk.

label: walk turning left
title: Walk turned to the left
instruction: Walk in place. Each time you are called, turn your body to your LEFT while you keep walking, or back to face the camera.

label: walk turning right
title: Walk turned to the right
instruction: Walk in place. Each time you are called, turn your body to your RIGHT while you keep walking, or back to face the camera.

label: walk and punch
title: Walk and punch
instruction: Walk in place, and punch now and then, as you would in the game.

label: straight left
title: Straight punches with the left
instruction: On your spot, in your guard. Each time you are called, throw ONE straight punch with your LEFT hand at the camera.

label: straight right
title: Straight punches with the right
instruction: On your spot, in your guard. Each time you are called, throw ONE straight punch with your RIGHT hand at the camera.

label: hook left
title: Hooks with the left
instruction: On your spot. Each time you are called, throw ONE hook with your LEFT hand: swing it across, at the height of your chin.

label: hook right
title: Hooks with the right
instruction: On your spot. Each time you are called, throw ONE hook with your RIGHT hand: swing it across, at the height of your chin.

label: uppercut left
title: Uppercuts with the left
instruction: On your spot. Each time you are called, throw ONE uppercut with your LEFT hand: from below, up to the chin.

label: uppercut right
title: Uppercuts with the right
instruction: On your spot. Each time you are called, throw ONE uppercut with your RIGHT hand: from below, up to the chin.

label: combos
title: Punch freely
instruction: On your spot, punch as fast as you comfortably can: straights, hooks and uppercuts, both hands. Do not step.

label: knee left
title: Knee strikes with the left
instruction: On your spot. Each time you are called, pull your LEFT knee up high, as a knee strike, and put it down.

label: knee right
title: Knee strikes with the right
instruction: On your spot. Each time you are called, pull your RIGHT knee up high, as a knee strike, and put it down.

label: duck
title: Ducks
instruction: On your spot. Each time you are called, DUCK under a punch (bend your knees and your back), and come up again.

label: jump
title: Jumps
instruction: On your spot. Each time you are called, JUMP with both feet, land softly, and stand again.

label: free
title: Box freely
instruction: Box as in the game: walk in place, turn, punch, kick, duck and jump, as you like.

label: stand 2
title: Stand on your spot
instruction: Back on your spot, stand still in your guard.
